senses.gloss:
चुक्क r. 10th cl. (चुक्कयति-ते) To inflict or suffer pain.
 E. चु-उभ-सक-सेट् ।

चुक्कार m. (-रः) The roaring of a lion.
 E. चक्क pain, derived from चुक्व with
भावे अच् affix, ऋ in the causal, to occasion, affix अच्; or चुक्कं पीड्न-
माराति सम्यक् ददाति आ + रा-क ।

चुक्र m. (-क्रः)
 1. Sorrel.
 2. Sourness.
 n. (-क्रं)
 1. Acid seasoning.
 2. Vine-
gar made by the acetous fermentation of grain.
 f. (-का or -क्री)
 1.
Indian sorrel, (Rumex vesicarius.)
 2. Hogplum.
 3. The tamarind.
E. चक् to satisfy, Uṇādi affix रक्, and the radical vowel changed to
उ; also with कन् चुक्रक.

चुक्रिका f. (-का) Indian sorrel, (Rumex vesicarius.)
 E. क्रन् added to the
preceding.
